overrun_policy: If an assessment exceeds its 20-minute planning allowance, defer the remainder to a later already-scheduled course-replacement or genuine repair slot only when it does not displace learner implementation, evidence, DSA, or interview/AWS work. If no compatible slot exists, leave the course and badge incomplete; do not add minutes.
course_slot_precedence: Required milestone-specific reading, worked examples, learner implementation, and evidence win. A course may use only overlapping concept-reading time; it never replaces a mandatory technical reference or accepted task.
reduced_ai_day_policy: For DSA sessions of 75 or 90 minutes, AI falls to 75 or 60 minutes. Skip optional course minutes first, keep the original required task/evidence, and resume only in a later already-scheduled compatible replacement or genuine repair slot. If none exists, defer the course; never add time.
resume_policy: Pause at the next incomplete course section when a slot is unavailable; do not skip ahead. Record the course as in_progress and its next section. Resume only in a later already-scheduled compatible course-replacement or genuine repair slot without displacing required work; no such slot is guaranteed.
conditional_slot_policy: The 440-minute map is a maximum, not guaranteed free capacity. The 120 M2.1 minutes on Days 43–48 are conditional and deferred by default because those days have mandatory specific readings and tasks.
openai_academy_badge_rule: course completion plus assessment score >= 80%; verify the badge from actual platform evidence
openai_api_pathway_certificate_rule: all five API-pathway courses completed and every assessment passed at >= 80%; this overlay maps all five but does not claim the pathway certificate
